entities.name: Malkoçoğlu Bâlî Bey
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Malkoçoğlu Bali Bey, also known as Malkoç Bey, was an Ottoman military commander and governor, he distinguished himself at the Battle of Mohács (1526). He then served as the Beylerbey of Budin Eyalet until 1541. Bali Bey was the commander of akıncı and gazis.
